method: Actual app/static/travel.js evaluated in Node VM with a minimal form DOM and controlled API promises. Validates state transitions; does not replace browser layout or SQL integration tests.

checks.case: saved choice restores slot, coupon, notes and contact without changing its dates
a saved slot that is no longer offered asks for a new choice instead of switching silently
moving the start date preserves the current stay length, including a user-edited checkout
search without a valid checkout receives a one-night checkout
a single-date package disables the hidden checkout instead of leaving a failing date constraint
a quote arriving after quantity changed cannot enable booking or submit the stale amount
equal prices on different dates do not make an obsolete quote valid
submit rechecks the actual selection even when a value changes without an input event
an older availability response cannot replace the newly selected date or package
an older quote cannot unlock controls while the newer quote is still pending
login resume saves all customer fields and restores them for the same package
